Title: `simplerouteview` refuses a missing or malformed token
Steps: 1. POST `simplerouteview` with no Authorization header 2. repeat with `Bearer not-a-jwt`
Expected result: both refused (HTTP 401/403, or HTTP 200 with `status` 0) and no data returned

Title: `simplerouteview` rejects a missing route_id cleanly
Expected result: a handled refusal (HTTP 200 `status` 0, or 4xx) with no data; never HTTP 5xx or SQL text

Title: `simplerouteview` handles a route id that cannot exist
Expected result: HTTP < 500; a handled envelope (`status` 0 or 1) with no rows for an input that cannot match; no SQL text
